unsettled: NO ROWS RECORDED, because Viet Nam's current official lists could not be read online. Viet Nam lists its controlled substances in the four Danh mục (lists) annexed to Nghị định số 28/2026/NĐ-CP (Government Decree No. 28/2026/ND-CP setting the lists of narcotic substances and precursors), dated and in force 19-01-2026 (vanban.chinhphu.vn; Công báo No. 82 of 4 Feb 2026). Every official copy that WebFetch can reach is a scan without a text layer: the decree PDF on vanban.chinhphu.vn and the four list PDFs linked from the Government newspaper. The only text copies, the Official Gazette's DOCX and PDF, are served from g7.cdnchinhphu.vn, which bars WebFetch by robots.txt. The Ministry of Justice database (vbpl.vn) lists the decree, but its search and document pages returned errors and its listing pages carry no links; vbpl.moj.gov.vn, moj.gov.vn, phapdien.moj.gov.vn and dav.gov.vn refuse WebFetch by robots.txt.

All 77 items are unread, so none is recorded as 'not found' (not_found is empty). By drug page: 2c-x (2C-B, 2C-I, 2C-E, 2C-C, 2C-T-7); 5-meo-dmt (5-MeO-DMT (5-methoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine)); amphetamine (Amfetamine, Dexamfetamine, Lisdexamfetamine); benzodiazepines (Diazepam, Alprazolam, Clonazepam, Lorazepam, Bromazepam, Etizolam, Flualprazolam, Flubromazolam); cannabis (Cannabis and cannabis resin, Delta-9-THC (dronabinol), Cannabidiol (CBD)); cocaine (Cocaine, Coca leaf); dmt-ayahuasca (DMT (N,N-dimethyltryptamine), Ayahuasca (the brew or its plants), if named); dxm (Dextromethorphan); fentanyl-and-analogues (Fentanyl, Carfentanil, Acetylfentanyl, Furanylfentanyl, Sufentanil, Remifentanil); ghb-gbl (GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyric acid), GBL (gamma-butyrolactone), 1,4-Butanediol); heroin (Heroin (diacetylmorphine)); ketamine (Ketamine, Esketamine); kratom (Mitragyna speciosa (kratom), Mitragynine, 7-Hydroxymitragynine); lsd (LSD (lysergide)); mdma (MDMA, MDA (tenamfetamine), MDEA (MDE)); mescaline (Mescaline, Peyote or San Pedro cactus, if named); methadone-buprenorphine (Methadone, Buprenorphine); methamphetamine (Methamphetamine (metamfetamine)); methylphenidate (Methylphenidate); pcp (Phencyclidine (PCP)); prescription-opioids (Morphine, Oxycodone, Hydrocodone, Codeine, Tramadol, Tapentadol); psilocybin (Psilocybin, Psilocin); salvia-divinorum (Salvia divinorum, Salvinorin A); synthetic-cannabinoids (JWH-018, AM-2201, 5F-MDMB-PINACA (5F-ADB), MDMB-4en-PINACA, ADB-BUTINACA); synthetic-cathinones (Cathinone, Cathine, Mephedrone (4-MMC), MDPV, alpha-PVP, 3-MMC, 3-CMC, 4-CMC (clephedrone), N-Ethylnorpentedrone (NEP), 2-MMC, 4-BMC (brephedrone)).

What the lists are, as reported but not read. The Government newspaper (baochinhphu.vn, 20 Jan 2026) and the Hưng Yên provincial portal report four lists: Danh mục I, substances absolutely banned from medicine and social life, 58 substances in IA and IB; Danh mục II, 476 in IIA and IIB; Danh mục III, 81; Danh mục IV, 79 precursors in IVA (31), IVB (30) and IVC (18). They, and Cần Thơ's legal-dissemination portal, also report that the decree ends Decrees 57/2022/NĐ-CP (25 Aug 2022) and 90/2024/NĐ-CP (17 Jul 2024). These are news reports, so none of this is recorded as fact; it is a guide for whoever reads the decree.

Lead for one item, from news only (unverified). The Government newspaper reports that lawful businesses dealing in 1,4-butanediol must comply with the precursor rules before 31 Dec 2026 (and that carisoprodol and etomidate, not items, are controlled from 1 Jun 2026). This suggests that 1,4-butanediol (ghb-gbl page) is now a listed precursor. Confirm it in Danh mục IV before recording it.

A second official list, under the pharmacy law, could not be read either. Thông tư số 18/2026/TT-BYT (Ministry of Health Circular on medicines and medicinal ingredients under special control; dated 01/06/2026, in force 16/07/2026; Công báo No. 329) is on the blocked Gazette CDN only, and was not found on vanban.chinhphu.vn. A text copy of an unsigned version (number and date left blank) is posted by Bạc Liêu General Hospital (https://bvdkbaclieu.gov.vn/upload/1000079/20260613/771_Thong-tu-18-2026-TT-BYT_5f0ad354fb.pdf). It was opened only as a finding aid: it appears to hold Phụ lục I (dược chất gây nghiện, narcotic drug substances), II (dược chất hướng thần, psychotropic drug substances) and III (tiền chất dùng làm thuốc, precursors used as medicines). No row was made from it, because a hospital is not the publisher and the version is unsigned. Even read, this list could only add medical-use detail; it cannot replace the decree's lists. Editor: decide whether that copy may be used.

The law and its implementing decree were not read. Luật Phòng, chống ma túy No. 120/2025/QH15 (adopted 10-12-2025) and Nghị định số 163/2026/NĐ-CP (dated 15-05-2026, in force 01-07-2026) are scans online. So their definitions, and whether any official list also names plants (relevant to coca leaf, cannabis, kratom, Salvia divinorum, peyote/San Pedro and the ayahuasca plants), could not be checked. The law's effect date is printed 01-07-2026 on vanban.chinhphu.vn and in the MPS database but 07/01/2026 on the Gazette page; this does not affect any item.

To settle (editor's decision; needed from Vasilis). Save the Official Gazette copies (PDF or DOCX) from these pages: Decree 28/2026/NĐ-CP, https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/nghi-dinh-so-28-2026-nd-cp-468827/62134.htm ; Circular 18/2026/TT-BYT, https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/thong-tu-so-18-2026-tt-byt-469674.htm ; Law 120/2025/QH15, https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/luat-so-120-2025-qh15-468574.htm. The Gazette copies are likely to carry text, since one is a DOCX (not checked, because the files could not be opened). A reader could then read the lists from the saved files, with the editor's leave, since the brief allows only WebFetch. Otherwise a human or OCR reading of the scanned lists on vanban.chinhphu.vn is needed. Until then Viet Nam has no national rows: the drug pages keep only the UN treaty layer, no drug page has an existing Viet Nam row, and the merge script reads this file as 0 rows on 0 drug pages.

Currency. No amendment of Decree 28/2026/NĐ-CP was found on 17 Oct 2026: the vanban.chinhphu.vn page lists no amending or consolidated text, the Gazette page's relationship chart shows no linked document, and searches found none. Whoever reads the lists should still check the Gazette from 4 Feb 2026 onward.
